content: Box2D v3.1 achieved cross-platform bit-identical determinism with floats by disabling FMA (-ffp-contract=off), avoiding fast-math, custom sinf/cosf/atan2f, keeping sqrtf (deterministic via SSE/NEON), strict creation/contact ordering; verified M2 vs Ryzen across MSVC/GCC/Clang; does not address WebAssembly or all compiler versions.
